components.name: Lattice guard precision and score-lattice arrangements
components.project_addition: Extend P024 from one-dimensional integer threshold translations to integer lattice states observed by a full vector of primitive affine guards. Pull each reachable future guard boundary back to a present hyperplane arrangement, factor the exact future-safe quotient through the common guard-score lattice, identify score-lattice-unrealizable rank cells, classify semigroup/group behavior separately in each observable direction, prove the strictly-positive-zero-relation criterion for global action-monoid group completion, and preserve the higher-dimensional infinite-hole counterexample as a boundary on one-dimensional conductor intuition. Generic quotient theory remains P023-owned and hidden guard-image reachability remains A3-owned.
